title: Canonical finite smooth purity maps and site transport
statement: Let A be a commutative ring in the module universe of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write C_T=nu_T^* for exact derived comparison, R_T=Rnu_{T,*}, and D_pro(T,A) for the fixed-module presentation. For finite A define Ctf(T,A) by intrinsic finite-stratification constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], an ordered bounded cohomology interval, and an ordered finite Tor interval tested on every degree-zero module sheaf [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. For a compactifiable f:X→Y, P_f is actual compact-support direct image on a selected compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], E_f=R_Y⋙f_A^times⋙C_X uses the ordinary compact-support right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. For an integer N annihilating A and d≥0, let L=A_X(d)[2d] be the ordered d-fold derived tensor of the actual finite etale root line shifted by 2, with zero power the coefficient unit [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf] and [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. An orientation alpha:f_A^times A_Y≅L is normalized if its diagonal pullback factor [def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates], followed by specialization of the t=1-normalized Rees family [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization], equals alpha followed by the Kummer-normalized normal-bundle integration adjoint [def-pur-finite-ring-section-data] and its exceptional transport to the actual normal cone through the homogeneous comparison [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-interfaces]. Define Gamma_0(K)=phi(K)∘(1 tensor alpha inverse), using the canonical smooth tensor counit transpose [thm-asd-smooth-tensor], and Tr_0=epsilon∘Rf_!(Gamma_0). The pro-etale source is actual derived pullback tensored with C_X L. Define its canonical comparison at C_Y K by the derived site/pullback comparison and the strong monoidal comparison. On Ctf, use the inverse comparison counit to define Gamma(K)=C_X Gamma_0(R_Y K) after this source comparison, and define its trace using the canonical open/proper compact-support site comparison [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] and both actual adjunction counits. Inverses and bounded-below site maps are extended by zero outside their respective loci so the definitions are total; all later assertions restrict to Ctf. These are definitions of the arrows and of the orientation-normalization predicate, without any assertion of purity or preservation. For A=Z/(ell^n), define RootSiteTransport to be an additive sheaf isomorphism from the comparison image of the degree-one root line, after forgetting its scalar action, to the actual pro-etale kernel mu_(ell^n). Require its composite with the kernel inclusion into units to send the image of every etale root generator 1 tensor z along every pro-etale test over an etale object to the pulled-back unit z. This determines the normalized identification and its Z/(ell^n)-action.
